properties.title: LP GRS Samarium 2° Elemental Abundance (low-altitude)
properties.lri:data_use_note: Samarium abundance in µg/g (equivalent to ppm) from LP GRS at 2° resolution (~60 km), low-altitude phase. Rare earth element elevated in KREEP-rich terrains. Note: µg/g and ppm are equivalent units by mass.
properties.lri:quality_note_short: Coverage limited to ~±71° latitude (polar caps masked as NoData). Negative pixel values within the data band are valid GRS counting-noise estimates, not missing data.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Raw INT16 binary (samarium2d.dat) scaled ÷10 via gdal_calc.py to obtain Sm ug/g as Float32; clamped noise-floor sentinel (raw -40) set to -9999 NoData (values -39 to -1 are valid counting noise and retained). Polar caps beyond ±71° latitude (rows 0–37 and 322–359, all-zero in source binary) set to -9999 NoData via Python/GDAL. Samarium derived from LP neutron and gamma ray spectrometer data (Elphic et al. 2000). Written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
